name: NPSNJ Mini-Grants and Conservation/Science Grants

summary: Mini-grants for volunteer groups, schools and individuals creating native habitat or doing conservation and restoration in New Jersey, plus two larger conservation/science grants for scientist-advised projects. Applicants must be NPSNJ members.
